decision.summary: A multi-component offset initiates near index 539: N rises sharply and sustains elevation, U jumps up and remains elevated, E steps down concurrently and shows additional perturbation ~545–546. All three axes show sustained deviation without observed return within allowed context [501,579]; thus status is uncertain. No evidence of reversal or recovery before index 579.

intervals.observation: N: sharp multi-sample upward jump starting ~539, sustained plateau until ~578; E: concurrent downward step at ~539–540, then a secondary offset ~545–546, remaining negative through 578; U: abrupt rise at ~539–540, elevated and noisy but not returning within allowed context. No opposing return observed for any axis in [501,579].
